t: Britain seized the Dutch Cape in 1795 to guard the route to India and kept it permanently from 1806.
Frontier wars against the Xhosa, the end of slavery in 1834 and the Great Trek shaped the colony and the whole region.
Self-governing from 1872 and enriched by diamonds, it became the Cape Province of the Union of South Africa in 1910.
dyk: From 1853 the Cape franchise was based on property or income, not race, so some Black and Coloured men could vote; that right was removed in 1936 and 1956.
ev: British forces take the Cape after the Battle of Muizenberg
Britain reoccupies the colony after the Battle of Blaauwberg
About 4,000 British settlers arrive in the Eastern Cape
Slavery is abolished across the colony
A parliament is elected on a non-racial property franchise
The Cape receives responsible government under John Molteno
Cecil Rhodes becomes prime minister of the Cape
The colony becomes the Cape Province of the Union of South Africa

f.founder: Great Britain (occupation under George Elphinstone and James Craig)
